title: Sprint 4 – Code Quality & Testing
description: Sprint Goal: Improve maintainability, reliability, and overall code quality while ensuring application stability.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 – Refactor Business Logic
tickets.description:
Business logic is scattered across views, making the project difficult to maintain.

Expected Work
Move business logic into service classes.
Improve code organization.
Preserve existing functionality.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 – Improve Exception Handling
tickets.description:
Unhandled exceptions produce inconsistent API responses and expose internal errors.

Expected Work
Implement centralized exception handling.
Return meaningful error responses.
Log unexpected exceptions.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 – Configure Application Logging
tickets.description:
Application errors are difficult to investigate because logging is incomplete.

Expected Work
Configure logging.
Log application errors.
Log critical events.
Improve debugging capability.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 – Fix Failing Unit Tests
tickets.description:
Several automated tests fail because of bugs introduced into the application.

Expected Work
Identify failing tests.
Fix application code.
Ensure all tests pass successfully.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 4 – Fix Failing Unit Tests

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 4 – Fix Failing Unit Tests

tickets.title: Ticket 5 – Increase Test Coverage
tickets.description:
Large parts of the application have no automated tests.

Expected Work
Write unit tests.
Add serializer tests.
Add API tests.
Improve overall test coverage.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 – Remove Dead Code
tickets.description:
The project contains unused functions, serializers, and views that increase maintenance complexity.

Expected Work
Identify unused code.
Remove obsolete components.
Ensure no existing functionality breaks.

tickets.title: Ticket 7 – Resolve Circular Import Issues
tickets.description:
Several modules depend on each other incorrectly, causing import errors and poor project structure.

Expected Work
Identify circular imports.
Refactor module dependencies.
Maintain application behavior.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 7 – Resolve Circular Import Issues

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 7 – Resolve Circular Import Issues
